# External References

Pinned reference-code clones are created here during Stage 1:

- `Visual-CoT/`
- `GroundingDINO/`

They remain independent ignored Git repositories. Record their exact commits
in `data/manifests/github_revisions.lock`.

`MMLongBench-Doc/` is reserved for Stage 14 and must not be cloned or populated
during Stages 0–4. Model weights never belong here in Git.
